The reference table grain is represented by twelve raised mesh streaks, which may add geometric edges (/evidence/final_source/build.py:50-53).
spatial_and_orientation_analysis: In the provided actual reference and delivered images, both show the bed across the foreground with the headboard on the left, shelving behind it, a side table and two lamps, and a foreground chair. The candidate frames the bed and shelving smaller and more centrally with more floor visible; the camera/layout differences confound object-size judgments. Reference chair and door are substantially cropped; candidate chair orientation and dark right-edge slab are only approximate. Evidence: provided reference and candidate images; /evidence/final_source/build.py:30-59,73-95.

The reference shelf shows six columns, while the student builds five columns and four rows (/evidence/final_source/build.py:31-34). Reference bed is more heavily cropped and foreground-dominant. Hidden orientations, room geometry, and absolute scale remain uncertain; no aligned world-coordinate errors are claimed.
appearance_and_resource_analysis: The reference has brighter, localized wall-light pools and a visibly patterned mattress and tabletop; the delivered render is more uniformly lit, with a smooth mattress and regular parallel tabletop stripes. These are visible comparisons, not causal isolation of lighting and material. Evidence: provided reference and candidate; /evidence/final_source/build.py:40-42,47-59,91-95.

The authored mat function sets constant Principled Base Color, Roughness and Metallic and does not construct texture, mapping or image nodes (/evidence/final_source/build.py:6-8). Wood grain uses rotated pale mesh strips, not texture coordinates (/evidence/final_source/build.py:50-53). No image-loading or packing operation is present in the delivered source; evaluator original summary reports no missing external images (/evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/summary.json:3-7). The source creates object geometry rather than a full-reference image plane (/evidence/final_source/build.py:19-89).
geometry_analysis: The cubby is assembled from intersecting horizontal shelves and continuous uprights; dark joint marks are visible in the candidate. The student's chair is a single subdivided solidified shell with four rods, not an established swivel mechanism (/evidence/final_source/build.py:30-34,73-84). The door is a narrow unparented block without a hinge assembly (/evidence/final_source/build.py:88-89; original object inventory:168).

Evaluator inventory places mattress bounds at z=0.36-0.74 and platform at z=0.20-0.40, so their bounding boxes overlap; this is broad-phase evidence only, not proof of an unintended mesh intersection (/evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/object_inventory.jsonl:46-51). The evaluator's 553 AABB overlap candidates are not confirmed collisions (/evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/summary.json:8).
